section_summary.extract_value: This section details the development of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), outlining its foundational assumptions and the selection of nine domains of creative achievement in the arts and sciences, with an additional tenth domain for Culinary. Indicators for achievement were drawn from previous research, rank-ordered, and weighted by expert professionals. The items were further refined based on expert feedback and reweighted after administration to a sample of 120 gifted university students.
